about.title: Frontend Multitool
about.intro: A collection of small, fast browser tools - and a place to make digital utilities feel as clear and pleasant as the work they support.
about.portfolioText: This project turns frontend craft into a tangible experience: useful utilities, a distinct interface, and thoughtful choices that begin before the code does.

principles.title: UI that makes work lighter
principles.description: Clear hierarchy, familiar interactions, and a visual rhythm that makes tools easy to scan on large and small screens alike.

principles.title: SEO with substance
principles.description: Clean page structure, useful metadata, and readable URLs give each tool a genuine chance to be found.

principles.title: Frontend as a product
principles.description: The focus is a fast, independent browser experience: small details, considered states, and an interface worth coming back to.

about.technicalIntro: Built as a Next.js app with a clear focus on performance, maintainability, and a polished interface - without account or API complexity that adds no value to these utilities.

technicalItems.title: Stack & tooling
technicalItems.description: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS 4 form the foundation. Lucide supplies icons, while qrcode, DOMPurify, and diff are used where they create real utility value.

technicalItems.title: Workflow & quality
technicalItems.description: The tool registry keeps pages and metadata consistent. Vitest covers logic, while ESLint and TypeScript guard changes. Claude Code supports the development workflow with research, iteration, and testing.

about.qualityIntro: Core Web Vitals measured with Lighthouse against the production build, desktop. No real field/CrUX data exists for this site, so Total Blocking Time is shown as a lab proxy for INP.

sections.title: Your privacy matters
paragraphs: We take privacy seriously. The short version: we do not collect, store, or transmit the content you use in these tools.

sections.title: TL;DR
paragraphs: Your data stays on your device. All tools run locally in the browser. Privacy is part of the architecture, not an afterthought.

sections.title: How the tools work
paragraphs: All tools run entirely in your browser. In practice that means:
bullets: No accounts or personal details required.

sections.title: What we store
paragraphs: Very little, and only locally: currently preferences such as theme and language so the interface stays consistent on your next visit.

sections.title: Third parties and cookies
paragraphs: There are no integrated tracking services. Theme and language preferences are stored locally, not managed through advertising or analytics cookies.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: Because no content is sent to a backend, there is no server-side data store for us to secure. It still makes sense for you to keep your browser up to date, especially on shared devices.

sections.title: Open source and contact
paragraphs: The source code is open to inspection. If you have questions, you can open an issue in the repository.
